- A specially created step-by-step video guide for visual learning
- 11 tea types and 11 brewing methods from different countries
- A practical guide for everyday brewing
- Timers for single brewing and multiple brews
- Helpful hints and explanations of the main tea-related terms
- Charming things and lots of love for tea!

Types of tea:
- Green
- Black
- White
- Yellow
- Pu'er
- Oolong
- Sencha
- Matcha
- Herbal teas (tisanes)

Brewing methods:

Chinese:
- Gaiwan
- Gong-fu brewer
- Small teapot
- Mug

Japanese:
- Matcha
- Kyusu

European:
- A regular teapot
- Teapot with a mesh filter
- Two teapots
- French press

Other
- The Russian style

P.S. A watch app is also included.
